priority: Focus next-quarter product effort on making the basic playback controls available and predictable for users on the basic tier, covering song selection, skipping, and seeking within tracks. The issue is coherent and actionable in the supplied issue metadata and ranks first in the actionable issue list. The three cited evidence records are typical severity-3 examples selected by severity frequency and centroid proximity, not worst-case examples.
rationale: The required baseline score is complaint_count × mean_severity = severity_sum, using complaint and cancellation records only. The topic rollup puts playback first at 31, followed by other at 28, usability at 25, and billing at 24; these are analytical topic estimates, not issue claims. The highest-ranked actionable, coherent issue is I_BILLING_01, which gives a specific product focus. Coverage denominators are 100 source rows, 100 classified rows, 0 quarantined rows, 0 unaccounted rows, and 52 complaint-or-cancellation rows; 5 classified rows came from gpt-6-luna and 95 from local_classifier. Among comparable full months, complaint-or-cancellation shares range from 0/2 in December 2022 to 16/19 in October 2023, so this small sample does not establish a stable trend. The 2022-06 and 2023-11 months are partial and excluded from that comparison.
sensitivity_interpretation: The sensitivity summary reports the same issue and topic ordering as baseline and explicitly says no verifier-based correction was fitted. Thus generic actionable=no issues such as I_PLAYBACK_01 are not promoted by a correction in this pack. If a fitted sensitivity model did elevate one, that would be a separate analytical signal warranting review, not an automatic override of the coherence/actionability criteria. No sensitivity intervals are supplied.
